workers.task: Implement the clean chat domain model: immutable committed messages, transient assistant draft representation, Room aggregate, IDs, timestamps, invariants, pure update functions, and thorough tests. No persistence or UI.

Implement the application-level chat orchestration layer around the existing TaskManager: send lifecycle, one active send per room policy, streaming draft accumulation, finalize/fail/cancel transitions, request ownership, and tests with fake executors. No provider-specific code.

Implement a clean storage port plus IndexedDB adapter architecture with transactional versioned records, atomic migration helper, corruption/error classification, interactive-recovery-friendly errors, and tests using deterministic in-memory/fake primitives where browser IndexedDB is unavailable.

Implement provider contracts and payload-shaping primitives: provider capabilities, normalized model descriptors, strict message validation requiring one leading system message, normalized errors, mock provider, and tests. Do not hard-code real secrets or network endpoints.

Implement a pure model router and provider health/cooldown planner with explicit route plans, fallback candidates, global wall-clock budget accounting, cooldown/429 handling metadata, deterministic scoring, and tests.

Implement memory/context domain primitives: versioned memory entries, immutable updates, deterministic context selection, token-budget abstraction that does not assume English-only ratios, migration contracts, and tests. No storage adapter edits.

Implement research evidence/citation contracts with canonical URL, retrievedAt, optional publishedAt, contentHash, evidence snippets, freshness classification, deduplication primitives, structured research failures, and tests.

Build reusable deterministic testing utilities for the remake: deferred promises, abort-aware fake streams, fake clocks/helpers, invariant assertions, scenario harness primitives, and self-tests. Do not change production domains.

Implement performance-budget primitives: monotonic deadlines, operation budgets, bounded queues, lightweight timing spans, long-task-safe scheduling abstractions, and tests. No global timers without ownership.

Implement reusable runtime contract/invariant validators for IDs, ISO timestamps, versioned payloads, discriminated result envelopes, serializable error shapes, exhaustive assertion helpers, and tests. Keep framework-agnostic.

Implement attachment ingestion domain primitives: immutable attachment metadata, hard byte budgets, MIME plus signature/content-sniff policy interfaces, single-flight loader primitive, cancellation-aware ingestion states, and race/retry tests. No UI.

Implement TypeScript-side Android bridge contracts: typed request/response envelopes, request IDs, capability negotiation, cancellation token mapping, structured bridge errors, SAF grant state types, mock bridge, and contract tests. No Java/Kotlin yet.

Implement provider-agnostic Deep Think orchestration primitives: two-pass reasoning, merge reasoning brief into the single leading system message, final payload revalidation hook, cancellation/deadline propagation, and tests proving no trailing system message can exist.

Implement GitHub Self-Dev domain/service primitives with token-state metadata only (never plaintext secrets), single-flight refresh coordinator, expiry skew logic, connection state machine, structured API errors, and concurrency tests using fake token providers.

Implement RPG/canon domain foundations: versioned immutable canonical snapshot, world/canon session identities, branch/title records, revision/checksum metadata, safe snapshot cloning, transactional change-set primitives, and tests. No UI or model calls.

Implement one shell-state store abstraction for active workspace, sidebar, dialogs, locale/direction, theme preference and viewport/keyboard state. Use immutable snapshots/subscriptions, single ownership, no direct DOM mutation, and tests.

Implement clean UI system services for locale/direction and theme scheduling: one timer owner, visibility/resume reconciliation API, auto/day/night preference state, RTL derivation, composition-safe locale metadata, and fake-clock tests.

Implement release-assurance primitives: deterministic payload manifest types, SHA-256 verification abstraction, installed-artifact identity comparison logic, release gate result aggregation, and tests. Keep platform-specific extraction behind ports.

Implement privacy-safe structured observability primitives: event schema, bounded ring buffer, task lifecycle correlation IDs, redaction helpers, error serialization, diagnostic export model, and tests. Never log message contents or secrets by default.

Implement AppKernel lifecycle foundations: explicit service registration, single start/shutdown ownership, dependency ordering without globals, idempotent boot, lifecycle states, failure rollback hooks, and tests including delayed dependency startup.
